theme.rationale: DutchVacancy is a student-focused employment platform in the Netherlands. A vibrant, clean, warm European light theme creates trust, credibility with Dutch employers (ABN AMRO, ASML, Booking.com style clean Dutch design), high readability for legal/visa rules (TWV work permit, zoekjaar orientation year), and approachable youthfulness for international students.

bilingual_support.toggle_style: Pill switch in navbar with national accent tag (EN / NL) + instant client state persistence

typography.voice_and_tone: Warm, energetic, pragmatic, optimistic. Speaks directly to international students overcoming language barriers and Dutch employers seeking global talent. Clear Dutch directness paired with international hospitality.

entry_surfaces./: split hero with Dutch canal & international student energy — Left: value proposition + interactive quick-search + visa filter pills; Right: live verified English-speaking job preview card stack and real-time student success counter
entry_surfaces./jobs: 3-column responsive job search — Left filter panel with Dutch cities & English level; Center scrollable job vacancy cards; Right interactive preview pane with instant 1-click application trigger
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — Left orange-tinted Dutch tech landscape showcase with student quotes; Right clean role switcher (Student vs Employer) and authentication form
entry_surfaces./register: branded split registration — Left Dutch work guidelines (16 hrs/week, TWV permit assistance, BSN checklist); Right multi-step student or employer registration form

accessibility.contrast_standards: All normal text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against solid surface. Large titles meet 3:1.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All clickable buttons, navigation links, filters, form fields, and status badges MUST include semantic 'data-testid' attributes (e.g. data-testid='job-card-apply-btn', data-testid='lang-switch-nl', data-testid='filter-english-only').
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Visible focus ring with offset (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-orange-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2)
accessibility.aria_labels: Explicit aria-label for language toggle, save job bookmark icon, filter collapse and modal dialogs

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENTATION STACK: Use React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 in frontend/src and FastAPI backend in backend/.

2. BILINGUAL EXPERIENCE (i18n): Create an internationalization helper (e.g. frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts or context) with complete EN/NL dictionaries for all static text, labels, badges, and navigation. Provide instant language switching with persistence in localStorage.

3. DATA SEEDING: Create a rich backend/seed.py populating: (a) 15+ high quality English student jobs in Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Eindhoven, Delft, Groningen with realistic pay (€15-€22/hr), (b) Verified Dutch employers (tech, hospitality, logistics, marketing, data, engineering), (c) Realistic demo user accounts (1 student, 1 employer, 1 admin), (d) Sample job applications with various status stages.
4. AUTHENTICATION: Build seamless cookie-based or JWT session auth for both 'Student' and 'Employer' roles with distinct dashboards.
5. DATA-TESTID PROTOCOL: Add comprehensive data-testid to every interactive component (job search inputs, filter checkboxes, apply modals, language switchers, submit buttons, dashboard tabs).

6. COMPONENT REUSE: Use pre-installed shadcn/ui components in frontend/src/components/ui/ (Dialog, Select, Tabs, Badge, Button, Input, Table, Card, Toaster) styled with our custom Dutch Orange/Navy aesthetic.

7. DUTCH LEGAL HELPER: Include educational info cards on Dutch employment rules: TWV work permits for non-EU students, 16 hours/week maximum during term time (or full-time in June/July/August), BSN requirement, and orientation year (zoekjaar).
